status: Read-path timing shortcut reproduced; hardware replacement not implemented

findings.subject: MAME workaround
findings.evidence: fdc_cmd_w remembers the command. fdc_data_r/fdc_data_w inspect command, DRQ and BUSY, assert external HALT and rewind PC by two bytes. fdc_drq_w clears external HALT when DRQ rises. The issue omits the analogous write handler from its list.
findings.runtime: 28 read-sector commands, 14336 delivered reads and 14336 rewound callbacks; typical callback gaps 24.5 then 7.5 microseconds.

findings.subject: Portable Juku shortcut
findings.evidence: Juku initializes paced_data to zero. A serviced read immediately exposes the next buffered byte. juku.c additionally clears write_sector_lead_pending after Write Sector commands. The shared controller supports pacing, enabled separately by Kaypro.
findings.runtime: Stock firmware IN loop period 49 CPU cycles (24.5 microseconds), shorter than the modeled 64-cycle (32 microsecond) media byte. Boot and DIR succeed.

findings.subject: Controlled perturbation
findings.evidence: Enable only paced_data in the investigation harness; no ROM or disk changes.
findings.runtime: Guest reports 04 DISK READ ERROR, never reaches EKDOS, and finishes with LOST DATA status. This establishes a missing synchronization mechanism in ours, not the exact hardware implementation.

findings.subject: MAME completion concern
findings.evidence: Driver clears the forced external HALT only on DRQ assertion; no INTRQ callback is connected. The BUSY check also calls status_r, a status acknowledgement.
findings.runtime: Not exercised for an error or completion without DRQ; deadlock/acknowledgement effects remain source-level concerns, not reproduced bugs.

findings.subject: Hardware boundary
findings.evidence: Sibling 8080-cosim schematic reviews leave the D96 remote clear source unresolved and portions of D96/D101 owner-board continuity unmeasured. Runnable HDL holds a related decoder input high.
findings.runtime: No physical hardware tested; these sources do not close a complete CPU wait-state equation.
